flashcard_questions.q: Whose granddaughter was Mary, Queen of Scots, giving her a claim to the English throne?
What age was Mary when she became Queen of Scotland?
What year did Mary return to Scotland as a widow?
Which of Mary's husbands was murdered in suspicious circumstances in 1567?
Which man, the chief suspect in Darnley's murder, did Mary marry three months later?
Who did Mary abdicate in favour of in July 1567?
In which month and year did Mary flee into England?
How many years was Mary held prisoner in England?
Which powerful nobleman planned to marry Mary, triggering the Northern Rebellion?
How many rebels marched south in the Northern Rebellion of November 1569?
Which cathedral did the northern rebels force their way into to hold a Catholic Mass?
How large was the royal army raised against the northern rebels?
How many rebels were executed as a warning after the Northern Rebellion?
Which earl was beheaded in 1572 after refusing to renounce his Catholic beliefs?
Which government body based in York had taken power from the northern nobility?

notes: 15 cards: 6 person to significance, 5 statistic, 3 event to date, 1 institution. Left Elizabeth's five options out because any card on them would be a list; the reasons for keeping Mary alive are causal essay material.
